final: WITH g AS (SELECT product_color AS color, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Products GROUP BY product_color), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.color, g.avg_price, g.cnt, g.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff FROM g JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_avg_price, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
